# atlassian_jira_group_members (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the account IDs of every member (active or inactive) of a Jira Cloud group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_jira_group_members" "reviewers" {
  group_id = atlassian_jira_group.reviewers.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group.

### Read-Only

- `account_ids` (List of String) Account IDs of the group's members, in the order Jira returns them.
